ash: Heads up folks 1 — PR #4410 preview failed: markdownlint (line-length), linkcheck (1 broken internal anchor), and spellcheck (1 word). https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410 :sweat_smile:

ci-bot: PR preview failed: markdownlint (MD013 line-length), linkcheck (1 broken link to `#quickstart-setup`), spellcheck (1 suggested: 'enviornment' -> 'environment'). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4410/logs

minh: I edited quickstart-setup header yesterday and forgot to update the reference in sdk-snippets.md. I can push a fix to the branch.

alexa: For the line-length, the linter flags long example CLI commands in examples/setup.md. We usually wrap long commands in backticks and add an html comment `<!-- mdast-preserve -->`? Is that still the pattern?

docs-bot: Recommended pattern: break long sentences, or wrap long commands with a fenced code block (triple backticks) to avoid MD013. See docs/style-guide.md#formatting-commands.

ash: typo is small, I'll correct 'enviornment' to 'environment' in the same commit.

minh: I'll open a small edit commit on the branch with three fixes: update anchor, fix typo, move the long CLI into a fenced code block. Will run `python scripts/linkcheck.py && make docs-preview` locally and push.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by @minh: queued. Expect ~5-7 min for linters and preview build.

alexa: Two quick policy questions: 1) Do we want to suppress MD013 for tables that exceed width? 2) Should we batch these tiny fixes or keep one commit per issue?

ash: For tables we usually allow longer lines; file a small .mdlint override if necessary. For this PR, batch fixes into a single commit to reduce churn on reviewers. Add a short note in the PR body describing the scope (anchor + style + typo).

minh: Pushed commit `fix: anchor, typo, wrap cli` to branch. Running preview locally now.

ci-bot: Build completed: linkcheck OK, markdownlint OK, spellcheck OK. Preview succeeded.

alexa: Great. Who's merging? We have a merge window at 16:00 PT. If someone can confirm post-ci I'll take it.

ash: I can merge at 16:00 PT if there are no outstanding approvals needed. PR has two reviewers listed (docs team) and both already approved in GH.

minh: Updated PR description to list changed files and note that edits are non-functional (format/typo/anchors).

ash: Merging at 16:00 PT. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

ash: Merged and closing thread. If anything crops up re: anchor redirects we can follow up in a separate PR.
